name: Joha
overview: Joha is a male figure identified as the Tizite and noted as the brother of Jediael. His tribal affiliation is not specified, and there are no additional notes providing further context about his life or role. He appears in the biblical record in 1 Chronicles 11:45.
namesAndTitles: The name Joha appears as a proper name in Scripture without any given meaning or title. There is no indication that the name was given directly by God, and no further significance is attached to the name in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Joha is explicitly identified as the brother of Jediael, establishing a clear familial relationship. Beyond this sibling connection, Scripture does not record any other family relationships for Joha.
scriptureSignificance: Joha's significance lies primarily in his identification as a Tizite and as the brother of Jediael, which situates him within a specific lineage or group mentioned in the biblical narrative.
